q1_issues.issue: The participial premodifier "drained" is left unencoded: a participle used as a modifier is an adjective, and a descriptive modifier on a definite plural distributes over the members as (Member $x drained), so a stated qualifier is silently dropped.

The per-member rule gives every lantern the same sk_nightmoth_1 handful as its Theme, asserting that each lantern individually attracts the whole handful, whereas the count is stated only of the aggregate.

notes: The context group symbol sk_lantern_1 is correctly reused with none of its atoms re-emitted, "a handful" takes the vague-quantity CardinalityPhrase form, and the solid compound gets its genus (Inheritance nightmoth moth) with no modifier genus for the noun modifier "night". Roles (inanimate transitive subject to Agent, unchanged object to Theme) and the statusless bare simple present are right.
